SELECT reportId, customerId, conversionStatusCode, customerName, reportUrl, sendStatusCode FROM ( SELECT cr.id AS reportId, cr.customer_id AS customerId, cr.conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, CASE WHEN cr.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN pc.name WHEN cr.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN ic.name END AS customerName, cr.report_url AS reportUrl, cr.send_status_code AS sendStatusCode, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY cr.conversion_status_code, cr.customer_id ORDER BY cr.created_at DESC, cr.id DESC ) AS rowNumber FROM customer_report cr LEFT JOIN potential_customer pc ON cr.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.id = cr.customer_id LEFT JOIN integrated_customer ic ON cr.conversion_status_code = '02' AND ic.integrated_customer_id = cr.customer_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( (cr.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId}) OR (cr.conversion_status_code = '02' AND ic.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId}) ) AND cr.id IN
#{reportId}
AND ( (cr.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId} AND pc.is_active = FALSE) OR ( cr.conversion_status_code = '02' AND ic.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId} AND ic.birth_date > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 21 YEAR) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM webform_response wr WHERE wr.customer_id = cr.customer_id AND wr.conversion_status_code = '02' ) ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM daily_action_item dai WHERE dai.customer_id = cr.customer_id AND dai.conversion_status_code = cr.conversion_status_code AND dai.sales_user_id = #{currentUserId} AND dai.target_date = CURDATE() AND dai.is_completed = FALSE )
) latest WHERE 1 = 1
AND rowNumber = 1
ORDER BY reportId
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_audit_log ( sales_user_id, target_customer_id, conversion_status_code, action_type_code, ip_address, user_agent, reason ) VALUES ( #{currentUserId}, #{targetCustomerId}, #{conversionStatusCode}, #{actionTypeCode}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{reason} )
